messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — we're getting close to RC cut tomorrow 10:00 PT. Can folks confirm status on dependency sweep + any vendor/submodule roll-ins? Need final lockfile bump + changelog lines before freeze.

maria: Working on python deps, opened PR #5043. Tests green locally, CI failing on mac wheel. Will ping infra.

sam: Vendor sync from upstream-lib had a conflicting patch to config.h — I resolved and pushed to my branch. Will re-run vendorize script. Also submodule update pending for telemetry repo.

kevin: FYI I'm going to hold all non-critical merges into release/* after 1 hour. If your PR is time-sensitive, tag me and explain the risk.

maria: CI fix: mac wheel pinned. Rerunning. If green I'll squash and request review.

jordan: For changelog — we need 1-line entries for each dep bump: package (from x.y -> x.z) — keep them terse. Add to CHANGELOG/rc-2026-03.md please.

sam: Re: submodule: telemetry is on branch feature/compact-kv, I bumped pointer to 3a9f7e. If anyone relies on the old API, speak now. Tests pass except a linter warning.

release-bot: deploy-checklist reminder — RC freeze in 9 hours. Please ensure locks updated and tag the release branch: v0.27.0-rc

kevin: Also, after lockfile bump run `scripts/validate-locks.sh` then `make smoke-release`. Leaving the exact commands here:
```
./scripts/vendor_sync.sh --dry-run
./scripts/validate-locks.sh
make smoke-release && ./tools/check-licenses.sh
```

maria: CI is green on my PR. Filed 5043-deps-bump. Added changelog line.

jordan: Thanks. Sam, can you open a short PR for the submodule pointer (no code changes) so we can include in changelog? Tag it "deps: submodule telemetry pointer".

sam: Done: PR #5072. Short description + changelog note. Marking for merge candidate.

kevin: I'll approve critical ones. After we merge these, freeze branch and cut rc. Reminder: no version bumps after freeze unless security bug.

maria: small note — the vendor pipeline reported a checksum mismatch for libfoo-2.1.2 on artifact store. Sam, can you check if your vendor sync altered packaging?

sam: Checking now. Might be a transient upload; I'll re-run and report.

jordan: Great — if anything blocks in next 2h ping me and we'll triage. :eyes:
